title: Cap pending path + feature-verify record verb + close-door gate (D1-D3)
action: Per CONTEXT D1/D2/D3, mirror named precedents: (1) packages/bee/lib/cells.mjs cap: new flag --feature-verify-pending — caps WITHOUT verify evidence, stamping trace.feature_verify='pending'; classic evidence path byte-unchanged; refuse combining the flag with recorded verify evidence claims. (2) New verb bee state feature-verify record --command <c> --output-file <f> --result green|red (register in command-registry beside state.route): stamps {command, output_sha256, result, at} onto the ACTIVE feature's workflow record (field feature_verify); red is storable, never satisfies D3; --show prints it. (3) Close-door guard mirroring guardTestCellDebt at BOTH doors (handleStateSet leaving swarming + handleStateScribingRun): typed refusal when any capped cell of the feature has trace.feature_verify==='pending' AND the workflow record lacks a GREEN feature_verify newer than the newest pending cap; message names the pending cell ids and the FIX (run the feature verify, record it, retry); NO gate_bypass level lifts it (guardTestCellDebt precedent). Allowlist tests (EXPECTED_STATE_EXPORTS, registry examples) updated as needed — declared. Vendored regen DEFERRED (wave-barrier ack).

feature-verify record round-trips green and red; red never satisfies the door.

Targeted suites green (test_bee_cli, test_cells if present, test_state).
prohibitions: Do NOT weaken the classic cap evidence path.
Do NOT let any bypass level lift the door.
